title: Law to require inspections of building street numbers
summary: This bill would require HPD and the FDNY to check for posted street numbers during their routine building inspections and to take enforcement action under Department of City Planning rules when numbers are missing or non-compliant. It would also require either agency to inspect a building within 60 days after a 311 complaint about a missing or improper street number. The law would take effect on January 1, 2027.
